text: dutiyasukkāsuttaṃ [834] ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe . tena kho pana samayena aññataro upāsako sukkāya bhikkhuniyā bhojanaṃ adāsi . [835] atha kho sukkāya bhikkhuniyā abhippasanno yakkho rājagahe rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi puññaṃ vata pasavi bahuṃ sappañño vatāyamupāsako yo sukkāya adāsi bhojanaṃ sabbaganthehi vippamuttāyāti 2 . ekādasamaṃ
